We need to propose a 3-step retrosynthesis for target: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have hints: step1 forward: carboxylic acid to amide (coupling). So retrosynthesis: break amide bond between C(=O)N and aromatic amine (aniline). So precursor: carboxylic acid (the unsaturated acid) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). The unsaturated acid is /C=C/C(=O)?? Actually target has /C=C/C(=O)N-aryl. So the acid precursor is the α,β-unsaturated acid: /C=C/COOH attached to phenyl sulfonyl? Wait structure: phenyl-sulfonyl attached to phenyl ring which has para substituent: /C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N. So the sulfonyl phenyl is attached to the unsaturated amide side chain. The amide is between the unsaturated acid and an aniline (c3ccccc3N). So step1: disconnection at amide: get unsaturated acid (with phenyl-sulfonyl attached) and aniline.

Step2: Doebner modification: forward forms α,β-unsaturated acid from aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid. So retrosynthesis: the unsaturated acid precursor can be derived from aromatic aldehyde (the phenyl ring attached to sulfonyl) and malonic acid. The aldehyde is the phenyl ring with sulfonyl substituent and a CHO group at para position? Actually the unsaturated acid is attached to phenyl-sulfonyl via a phenyl ring (c2ccc(... )cc2). The side chain attaches at para position of that phenyl: /C=C/COOH. So the aldehyde precursor would be the same phenyl-sulfonyl ring with CHO at that position (para). So we need to propose that.

Step3: sulfonamide formation: forward: amine reacts with sulfonyl chloride to give sulfonamide. In target, we have sulfonamide linking the first phenyl (with methyl) to the sulfonyl phenyl. So retrosynthesis: break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonyl fluoride) and aniline (the methyl phenyl with NH). So precursor: p-toluidine (Cc1ccc(N)cc1) and sulfonyl chloride: ClSO2-Ph-? Actually the sulfonyl chloride attached to phenyl-sulfonyl ring (c2ccc...). So we need sulfonyl chloride: ClSO2-c2ccc(... )cc2 where the ... is the unsaturated acid side chain (still attached). So after step2 we have that phenyl-sulfonyl with unsaturated acid attached as substituent (still). So step3: sulfonamide formation between p-toluidine and sulfonyl chloride.

Thus three steps: 1) amide coupling, 2) Doebner modification, 3) sulfonamide formation.

Now we need to find template IDs for each transformation. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria for each.

First, sulfonamide formation: functional_groups_broken: sulfonamide? Actually forward forms sulfonamide, so retrosynthesis breaks sulfonamide into sulfonyl chloride and amine. So we need template that breaks sulfonamide to sulfonyl chloride + amine. Search with functional_groups_broken: ["sulfonamides"] and functional_groups_formed maybe ["sulfonyl chloride","primary amines"]? But we can just search broken sulfonamide.
